results.releaseNotes:
## New features

- Library filters take multiple values, exclusions and ranges
- Downloads tabs can group, sort and filter
- Tag suggestions in the tag editor
- Quick Tag in the item context menu
- Shuffle Starts at Beginning setting
- A volume pill shows every volume change in the player
- The Watch Together session code is large enough to read across a room

## Performance

- Libraries in folder view open with fewer server requests
- Collections without a backdrop skip the poster blur on Reduced visual effects

## Playback

- Ambient lighting turned on in settings applies when playback starts
- Subtitles stay in place with Ambient lighting after moving to the next episode
- Files whose tracks end early finish and offer Play Next
- Switching episode or quality in place waits for the new file's first frame
- The skip badge matches the distance the playhead moved
- A slow server response no longer overwrites a replaced play queue
- The player no longer leaks memory each time it closes
- Transcoded playback starts through reverse proxies that send chunked responses
- HDR10+ switches the TV to HDR10+ instead of HDR10 on Apple TV
- Watch Together rooms start on Apple TV
- Playing alone in a Watch Together room starts on the first Play press

## Subtitles

- PGS subtitles no longer draw a box behind the text

## Live TV

- Live TV shows in system media controls, Now Playing and Google Assistant
- Next and previous change channel from media controls and the companion remote
- A short rewind at the live edge moves back instead of doing nothing
- Guide reloads and recording rule runs report failures instead of claiming success
- Favorite channels are included in settings export

## Jellyfin & Emby

- External players open ISO files from Jellyfin
- Downloads keep their SRT subtitles on Jellyfin
- The Collections tab lists collections on Emby servers without a collections folder

## Explore & trackers

- Unwatching resets MAL and AniList progress instead of deleting the list entry
- A failed watchlist add on Plex shows an error instead of doing nothing

## Downloads

- Downloads stop before the device runs out of storage
- Show and season badges count downloaded episodes
- Downloads from different servers no longer merge into one show or album
- A shared download removed from a profile leaves that profile's list
- The offline play-next card shows its thumbnail on Jellyfin and Emby

## UI

- Error messages no longer show raw technical text
- Titles without a logo get a wider slot and shrink to fit instead of truncating
- Low-density phones get the phone layout instead of the tablet one
- Hovering an always-open sidebar no longer dims the content
- Settings that fail to apply show why instead of crashing
- Out-of-date translations refreshed in every language

## Apple TV

- The focused player control is a solid disc that stands out over video
results.description:
Plezy is a modern client for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby, built for high-quality playback, effortless discovery, and offline access. Connect multiple servers at once and enjoy your media in one clean, native app—no subscription required.

BROWSE & DISCOVER
- Browse libraries, collections, playlists, folders, extras, and personalized recommendations
- Search across every connected Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby server
- Explore trending, popular, watchlist, and recommendation rows from Plex Discover, Trakt, MyAnimeList, AniList, Simkl, and Seerr
- Match catalog titles back to your own libraries and request movies or shows through Seerr
- See resolution, HDR, Dolby Vision, and audio-format badges at a glance

PLAYBACK
- Wide codec support including HEVC, AV1, VP9, and more
- HDR playback, direct play, and configurable transcode quality
- Switch between media versions with detailed file and stream information
- Full ASS/SSA subtitles with styling controls and online subtitle search
- Auto-play the next episode with skip intro and skip credits
- Chapter navigation, thumbnail scrubbing, playback speed, audio sync, sleep timer, and video zoom
- Picture-in-Picture, loudness normalization, and stereo downmix with center-channel boost
- Resume progress and remembered audio/subtitle choices

MUSIC
- Browse artists, albums, and tracks with rich artwork
- Gapless playback with a reorderable queue, Play Next, and Add to Queue
- Synced lyrics, a persistent mini-player, and sleep timer
- Background playback with lock-screen and media controls
- Offline albums and tracks, plus selectable streaming quality

LIVE TV & DVR
- Browse and tune live channels with favorites and a full program guide
- See what's on, browse show schedules, and manage DVR recording rules
- Use Live TV across multiple supported servers

DOWNLOADS & OFFLINE
- Download movies, shows, albums, and tracks
- Pause or resume the background queue
- Create automatic download rules, including optional show specials
- Browse offline and sync watch state when you reconnect

PROFILES & INTEGRATIONS
- Use multiple profiles with per-profile settings, downloads, and watch state
- Switch Plex Home users with optional PIN protection
- Discover Jellyfin and Emby servers locally and use Quick Connect
- Sync watchlists, ratings, watched state, and scrobbles with connected services
- Watch together with synchronized play, pause, and seeking
- Control desktop and TV devices with Plezy Remote
- Available in English plus 21 translations

Some features require a supported server, media format, or connected service.

results.releaseNotes:
## New features

- Live TV recording on Jellyfin and Emby

## Performance

- Cold start reaches the first screen ~500 ms sooner
- Player chrome no longer rebuilds on every tick
- Artwork nothing displays is no longer decoded

## Playback

- Downloaded subtitles apply instead of failing
- Quoted mpv.conf values take effect
- Preferred languages no longer match unrelated tracks
- A secondary subtitle no longer replaces the primary
- A cleared intro pattern no longer marks every chapter
- Play/pause no longer crashes during teardown
- Progress reporting survives failed retries
- Dismissing Still Watching re-arms the sleep timer
- Scoped audio sync offsets display correctly
- iPadOS PiP no longer resizes with SRT subtitles

## Plex

- Tags with spaces, symbols, or commas remove correctly
- Recording indicators appear in the EPG
- Scheduled programmes offer Manage, not Record
- "Other Videos" render as 16:9 thumbnails
- Unreachable servers show an error, not empty lists
- Discover keeps its hubs when one leg fails
- Plex QR and browser sign-in can be cancelled

## Jellyfin & Emby

- Date Added sorting works on rows and albums
- Unplayed Next Up items sort correctly
- Editing a release date updates the year
- The guide keeps already-airing programmes
- Two profiles on one server no longer share caches
- Add-server lists existing servers, per backend

## Explore & trackers

- Jellyseerr request states decode correctly
- Failed requests can be re-requested
- Queued tracker writes purge on disconnect and expiry
- Rewatch updates use post-write state
- Dismissing device-code sign-in cancels the attempt
- Concurrent tracker sign-ins on one network succeed

## Downloads

- Recovery finds files on a custom location
- One offline server no longer stalls the queue
- Queued items resume when their server returns
- Partly cancelled seasons no longer show completed
- Deleting a season no longer orphans thumbnails
- Offline metadata resolves per profile
- Cancelled downloads no longer commit empty files

## Profiles & startup

- Managing a PIN-protected profile requires its PIN
- The mandatory profile picker cannot open twice
- Returning from playback keeps the detail page
- Repair works on the startup-failure screen

## UI

- Detail hero chips fit on one row
- Episode rows show the real episode number
- Library switcher and profile menu are sheets on phones
- Hub "see all" cards match their source rows
- Explore no longer scrolls the app bar away
- The file-info spinner dismisses with its card
- Library tabs refetch after long backgrounding

## Remote & controllers

- Pairing no longer hangs on unroutable addresses
- The remote reconnects after backgrounding
- Fixed the top crash in LAN discovery
- Gamepad disconnect stops runaway key repeat
